summary: Breaking an undead-turning wand skips its source floor-object callback for a dropped corpse. C do_break_wand() sets affects_objects for WAN_UNDEAD_TURNING and calls bhitpile(..., bhito, ...) on the floor pile, so the already-ported bhito() revives the corpse. JavaScript do_break_wand() currently records zap.c bhito as unported for this effect. The later collect_coords() RNG-bound mismatch is downstream of the missing revival, not a collect_coords defect.

source.branch: After the wand passes the break gates and its magical explosion, WAN_UNDEAD_TURNING sets affects_objects. During the eight-neighbor-plus-hero pass, a floor pile at the target square reaches bhitpile(obj, bhito, ...); for the claimed recipe, the hero-square pile contains the dropped newt corpse and the callback revives it.
callers: apply.c:doapply() dispatches an applied WAND_CLASS object to do_break_wand(); js/apply.js:doapply() has the corresponding dispatch.

apply.c:do_break_wand() calls bhitpile(obj,bhito,x,y,0) in both the adjacent-square and hero-square object branches; js/apply.js:do_break_wand() currently gates bhitpile() to striking/polymorph and substitutes note_unported for other effects.
dependencies: zap.c:bhitpile() is already implemented in js/zap.js and iterates the floor-object pile with its callback.
zap.c:bhito() is already implemented in js/zap.js, including WAN_UNDEAD_TURNING corpse -> revive().
The later revive placement reaches teleport.c:collect_coords(); that existing helper is the downstream RNG observation, not the missing source owner.

evidence: .cache/a2-v38-broken-undead-wand.scan.log reproduces 55 recorded steps and the first divergence at segment 0, step 53: C consumes rn2(8)=4 in collect_coords(teleport.c:700), JavaScript consumes rn2(19)=1, and the diagnostic reports unported zap.c bhito.

The admitted recipe challenges/cases/v38/v38-broken-undead-wand-revives-floor-newt.recipe.session.json wishes an undead-turning wand and newt corpse, drops the corpse, and breaks the wand. Its recording is unchanged and has the v38 manifest/recording hashes retained above.

apply.c:4015-4020 marks WAN_UNDEAD_TURNING as affecting objects; apply.c:4037-4146 processes neighbors and then the hero square, calling bhitpile(obj,bhito,x,y,0) at 4099-4103 and 4117-4121. apply.c:doapply() dispatches WAND_CLASS to do_break_wand() at 4234-4235.

js/apply.js:4786-4800 contains the missing behavior: despite affectsObjects, it calls bhitpile() only for WAN_STRIKING or WAN_POLYMORPH, otherwise note_unported('zap.c bhito'). js/zap.js bhito() has the C undead-turning corpse branch and calls revive(); js/teleport.js collect_coords() is reached downstream during revived-monster placement.

GOALS.json has older do_break_wand evidence for WAN_NOTHING and WAN_LIGHT recordings, but that evidence does not cover this undead-turning floor-object callback and its sourceReview omitted the current zap.c:bhito caller gap.
